summary: Backend-only (shell script) testing of deploy/gdrive-backup.sh retry mechanism. Verified pending marker lifecycle, --retry no-op/retry-until-success behavior, --install-cron systemd unit generation (daily + 15-minute retry timer), simulator across all modes (retryflow, ok, mysqlfail, drivefail), bash syntax check, .gitignore coverage, and docs. All checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Line 86: when --retry runs and another backup already holds the flock, the script silently exits 0 without logging (intentional for timer noise reduction, but a single-line log entry would help diagnosis).

cp .env "$OUT/env.txt" (line 110) packages the full .env (including GDRIVE_TOKEN/CLIENT_SECRET) into every tar uploaded to Drive. Acceptable if Drive folder is private, but worth noting as a confidentiality risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simulator at /app/tests/gdrive_backup_sim.sh covers retry flow, ok, mysqlfail, drivefail. For --install-cron verification without real systemd, copy /app/deploy to a tmpdir, sed-replace /etc/systemd/system to a tmp path, and stub systemctl+crontab in PATH (see iteration_3 testing steps). Expected: 4 units written (crm-gdrive-backup.service/.timer with OnCalendar=*-*-* 00:00:00 <TZ>, crm-gdrive-backup-retry.service with ExecStart including --retry, crm-gdrive-backup-retry.timer with OnCalendar=*:0/15), systemctl daemon-reload + enable --now on both timers.

verifications.bash_syntax: bash -n gdrive-backup.sh and gdrive_backup_sim.sh both OK
verifications.simulator_retryflow: STEP0 EXIT=0 PENDING=no UPLOADS=0; STEP1 EXIT=1 PENDING=yes UPLOADS=0; STEP2 EXIT=1 PENDING=yes UPLOADS=0; STEP3 EXIT=0 PENDING=no UPLOADS=1; STEP4 EXIT=0 PENDING=no UPLOADS=1 — matches spec
verifications.simulator_ok: EXIT=0 PENDING=no, tar uploaded with env.txt+mysql.sql.gz+3 volume tars
verifications.simulator_mysqlfail: EXIT=1 PENDING=yes (marker retained on backup.sh failure)
verifications.simulator_drivefail: EXIT=1 PENDING=yes (marker retained on rclone failure)
verifications.install_cron_units: All 4 units generated with correct OnCalendar values; retry service ExecStart includes --retry; systemctl enable --now called on both timers; legacy crontab line removed
verifications.docs: DEPLOY_IDCLOUDHOST.md explains the retry marker + 15-min retry timer
